title: 第八百九十七章 五行星兽第八百九十六章 我跟她是清白的
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始
content_zh:
自离开乱星域结界后，顾尘风便一路北上，全速前进。
最终，在第七日清晨，终于逼近了迷雾深林北部边境。
此时，浓雾环绕的森林中，一道寒光闪过。
“噗嗤……！”
鲜血瞬间喷涌而出。
一尊有着一流实力的强大星兽，被当场立劈成两半。
顾尘风抬手，将其身体内的一枚星晶摄入手中，塞入身后包裹。
随即神识一扫，确定周围并无星兽活动，又锁定了一株最为粗壮高大的古树。
顾尘风身形一闪，飞速攀登到古树之巅，越过深林中萦绕的迷雾，向着北方天地望去。
只见北方天地间，厚重的乌云如墨般翻涌低垂，将那片天空染得一片晦暗。
道道粗壮刺目的闪电撕裂云层，伴随着震耳欲聋的雷鸣，不断劈落。
在这片狂暴的雷域中心，一座巍峨雄浑的巨峰刺破云海，屹立于天地之间。
神峰周身笼罩着流转不息的五色霞光。
即使在漫天电闪雷鸣与阴沉乌云的映衬下，神峰依旧璀璨夺目，散发出一种令人心悸的磅礴威势。
“这就是五雷神山吗！”
顾尘风遥望着这座巍峨大山，即便相距还有较为遥远的距离，内心依旧感到难以言说的震撼。
同时，顾尘风内心还莫名悸动，生出一种向往之感。
心中暗暗吃惊于这座大山的神奇，顾尘风却没有急着赶路。
此地距离五雷神山不过数百里，以他的脚程，即便在星兽横行的迷雾森林，个把时辰就能抵达。
在行动之前，顾尘风决定先将自己的状态恢复到最佳。

“裂空王说过，五雷神山只有一条上山之路，被那人占据。
所有想要登山之人，都要提供能够延寿的天地灵物，让那人满意，才会让出通路。”
顾尘风的行囊里，有着不少殷红鸾采摘自五雷神山的灵物，都有一定的延寿功效。
按照曾经她和此人的交易价格来算，这宝物的价值，足有以往交易价格的两倍不止。
尽管如此，为了保险起见，在与对方交易前，顾尘风还是得令自己的状态达到巅峰。
他直接取出一些顶级血晶握在掌心，开始运功修炼。
一直修炼到午后时分，顾尘风才缓缓睁开双眼，眸中似有电光闪烁，神采奕奕。
“状态已经恢复巅峰，出发！”
顾尘风直接从高处跃下，在浓雾环绕的密林中，快速前行。
越靠近迷雾森林边界，森林中的星兽活动的越发频繁，实力也更强大。
顾尘风一路又斩杀数尊强大星兽。
终于在夜幕降临前，靠近了五雷神山脚下。
此刻，密林中的雾气，也变得稀薄了许多，眼前的五雷神山宛如擎天之柱，直入青冥。
五色神光环绕巨峰，伴随着震耳欲聋的雷霆轰鸣之声，狰狞雷电如翻涌怒潮，笼罩在山岳表面。
content_en:
After leaving the boundary of Chaos Star Territory, Gu Chenfeng went all the way north and moved forward at full speed.
Finally, in the early morning of the seventh day, they finally approached the northern border of the misty forest.
At this time, a cold light flashed through the forest surrounded by thick fog.
"Pfft...!"
Blood spurted out instantly.
A powerful star beast with first-class strength was split in half on the spot.
Gu Chenfeng raised his hand, took a star crystal from his body into his hand, and stuffed it into the package behind him.
Immediately, he scanned his consciousness to confirm that there were no star beasts moving around, and then locked onto the strongest and tallest ancient tree.
Gu Chenfeng flashed and quickly climbed to the top of the ancient tree, looking past the mist lingering in the deep forest towards the northern world.
I saw thick dark clouds rolling down like ink between the sky and the earth in the north, dyeing the sky into darkness.
Thick and dazzling lightning tore through the clouds, followed by deafening thunder.
In the center of this violent thunder field, a majestic and majestic peak pierced the sea of ​​clouds and stood between heaven and earth.
The whole body of the sacred peak is shrouded in the endless flow of five-color glow.
Even against the backdrop of lightning, thunder and gloomy clouds, the peak is still dazzling, exuding a heart-stopping majestic power.
"Is this the Five Thunder Mountains?"
Gu Chenfeng looked at this majestic mountain in the distance. Even though it was still far away, he still felt indescribable shock in his heart.
At the same time, Gu Chenfeng's heart was still inexplicably throbbing, and he felt a sense of yearning.
Secretly surprised by the magic of this mountain, Gu Chenfeng was not in a hurry.
This place is only a few hundred miles away from the Five Thunder Mountains. With his pace, even in the misty forest where star beasts are rampant, he can reach it in a matter of hours.
Before taking action, Gu Chenfeng decided to restore his condition to its best.
"King Kong Kong said that there is only one way up the Five Thunder Mountains, and it is occupied by that person.
Anyone who wants to climb the mountain must provide spiritual objects from heaven and earth that can prolong life, and only then will the path be cleared to satisfy the person. "
In Gu Chenfeng's luggage, there are many spiritual objects picked by Yin Hongluan from the Five Thunder Mountains, all of which have certain life-extending effects.
Based on the previous transaction price between her and this person, the value of this treasure is more than twice the previous transaction price.
Despite this, for the sake of safety, Gu Chenfeng still had to reach the peak of his condition before trading with the other party.
He directly took out some top blood crystals and held them in his palm, and began to practice his skills.
After practicing until the afternoon, Gu Chenfeng slowly opened his eyes. There seemed to be lightning flashing in his eyes, and he was full of energy.
"The state has returned to its peak, let's go!"
Gu Chenfeng jumped directly from a high place and moved forward quickly in the dense forest surrounded by thick fog.
The closer you get to the border of the misty forest, the more frequent the star beasts in the forest are and their strength becomes stronger.
Gu Chenfeng killed several powerful star beasts along the way.
Finally, before nightfall, we approached the foot of the Five Thunder God Mountain.
At this moment, the mist in the dense forest has become much thinner, and the Five Thunder Mountains in front of us are like pillars of heaven, reaching straight into Qingming.
Five-color divine light surrounded the giant peak, accompanied by the deafening roar of thunder, and the ferocious thunder and lightning covered the surface of the mountain like a roaring tide.
